offering_description.value: Coty sells prestige fragrances and mass-market beauty products. It develops products under owned and licensed brands, makes them in its own facilities and through contract manufacturers, and sells them through retailers, distributors and online stores.

primary_products.value: fragrances; color cosmetics; nail products; skin care; personal care products

customer_segment.value: B2B: Department stores, specialty beauty chains, mass merchants, drugstores, duty-free retailers and beauty distributors; B2C: Fragrance, makeup and skin care shoppers buying directly online

end_markets.value: prestige beauty; mass-market beauty and personal care; travel retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: Wholesale and direct sales of fragrances, cosmetics, nail products, skin care and personal care products

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns fragrance ingredients, cosmetic ingredients and packaging into finished products for retailers and distributors; brand owner: Develops and markets contract-made beauty products under owned and licensed brands for retail and online shoppers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Latin America, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: Prestige fragrances, makeup, nail products, skin care and mass-market personal care

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Wholesale accounts with department stores, beauty chains and mass merchants; third-party retail: Department stores, specialty beauty stores, mass merchants, drugstores and airport duty-free shops; online: Brand websites, online beauty retailers and marketplaces; distributors / dealers: Local beauty distributors supplying retailers in international markets
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; third-party retail; online; distributors / dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Cosmetic ingredients, safety and labeling are subject to FDA rules and the EU Cosmetics Regulation.

notes: Recent changes to the mass-market beauty portfolio are uncertain.
